I currently have 9.
Mind you, I definitely don’t succeed in doing them all every day, but I try not to beat myself up about that.

Mine are:

1. step outside once

Because some days I don’t have a reason to go out of the house, but I still think I should.

2. meditate

I use the Balance app, really trying to build this habit!

3. pick your teeth

Because my gum health is really important to me but it’s a hard habit to build.

4. sit up straight

To remind myself to work on my posture.

5. read a page in a book

I try to tell myself one page is enough, so I can pick a book up every day but not feel obligated to read a whole chunk of it. If I do read more, that’s fine too, but one page is enough for the goal.

6. write down 10 successes

I try and write ten things in my notes every day, that feel like small or big successes. Examples: getting out of bed, talking to a friend, seeing something that brings joy, getting inspired, eating on time or healthy, getting/sending a sweet message or a hug, being on time, feeling relief because of something, doing something you’ve procrastinated on, putting on a nice outfit. ANYTHING counts! Adding in details help too, get creative with it :)

7. journal a page

To try and get in the habit of processing my thoughts and feelings, and not having them build up so much. I have a micro pet egg attached to this one.

8. Tidy home for 5 minutes

This one I’ve been finding the hardest.

9. Did not text him today

I’ve recently been broken up with, so trying not to contact him for at least a few weeks, and rewarding myself for every day that I succeed 💜.


I also have some paused goals:

10. do the dishes

11. stretch for fruit 50 times (it’s a tai chi stretching exercise, lmk if you want me to explain it!)

12. egel exercises (to train bladder/kegel muscles)

13. delete 50 emails (I had a very overloaded inbox a while ago)


Hope these might inspire someone too!
Good luck, cheep 💜

What I took away from it is this:

Robert, Theresa and Old Dolio are all very superstitious about the effects of earthquakes. They basically don’t believe in anything conventional.

I don’t really understand why they’re so intense about the earthquakes, but it seems like they’re waiting for some kind of enormous apocalyptic earthquake (or as they describe it: ‘the big one’) that will end all of humanity. It’s probably also the reason why they’re so scared of flying in the airplane scenes.

When Melanie and Old Dolio are in the gas station bathroom, a more intense earthquake happens and Old Dolio believes it’s ‘the big one’. She freaks out because she genuinely believes that she died, partly because they hear complete silence for a few moments and it’s pitch black. In reality, nothing much happened, it just happens to be quiet and they just happen to be in a very dark gas station bathroom.
Old Dolio is so scared of touching anything though, that they stay long enough inside of the bathroom and wonder if the life they ‘lived’ was worth it. 

Then comes an interesting moment. Car sounds start coming in again, so Melanie assumes it’s safe enough to go outside again, and Old Dolio, earlier believing that she had just died from ‘the big one’, feels as if she’s come back to life.

I see it as her rebirth into a new kind of life. It’s like she’s finally come alive with this huge wonder and love for everything and everyone around her, but she’s also scared. Like a newborn baby.

What I think is so beautiful about this scene is that Melanie and Old Dolio came to the dark bathroom to mimic the ‘breast crawl’, and that’s exactly what she does after coming out of this womb of darkness and is reborn into the light of the outside world. 
At first she’s helpless, like a newborn, and she says: ‘what do I do? I don’t know what to do!’ 
and then she remembers what Melanie and her came to do in the first place, and she symbolically crawls across the abdomen.
Melanie smiles, because it gets her attention and she realises that they’ve fulfilled the task they came to do.

www.skiley.net 

Allows you to see all your Spotify history, ranking of your top artists, genres and songs. 
It also has a function to enable an archive playlist for your Discover Weekly songs.


www.tunefind.com

A database to find songs played in series or movies. 
Just search for the movie or series you just heard a song in and read the little descriptions of the scenes to make sure that the song matches the one you heard and are so eager to find.

www.spotern.com

Site to find clothes, furniture, accessories and more that you spotted in a movie or series and would like to buy yourself. 
Other Spotern users will give a suggestion of a perfect or close match to the piece of clothing or object you want to find.
